adaptation_note: The public AIR implementation does not support ReVA Qwen3-VL. ReVA ports its event segmentation, density allocation, local refinement, and exact-budget fallback while retaining the Qwen3-VL-8B answerer. EVA-CLIP-L is not cached on the authorized HPC runtime; the frozen SigLIP2 cache is used as the query/frame similarity signal and is labeled as an AIR-style adaptation.

short_clip_policy.gmm_threshold_method: max(low_mean + 0.5*(high_mean-low_mean), high_mean - coefficient*high_std), clipped to observed range; ReVA adaptation, not exact paper convention

interval_refinement.potential: max measured candidate relevance in selected-boundary interval + 0.25*(interval relevance range) + 0.05*interval temporal span
interval_refinement.method_note: ReVA deterministic interval-potential adaptation; not a claim of the paper's unavailable Qwen3/EVA implementation
interval_refinement.neighbor_measurement: pending Qwen3-VL VLM batch; no inherited similarity

processor_budget.resolution_tradeoff: frozen baseline VIDEO_SIZE; 32/64-frame arms lower per-frame grid density and must report this confound
